description: Signed one-click unsubscribe links for your unsubscribe-list, one per recipient, with the exact List-Unsubscribe and List-Unsubscribe-Post headers to add to that email. Only computes them: nothing about the recipients is stored, the same address always gets the same link, and a link never shows the address. Entries that are not addresses are marked not_an_address; when none is an address the answer is suppression_no_address.

instance_id.description: Utility instance id from buy or list_utilities.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if your client cannot send it as an Authorization header; leave it out when your MCP app signed in.

name: unsubscribe_links
title: Make signed unsubscribe links
